data.name: Haajirah
data.gender_notes: Haajirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'hajara' which means 'to migrate, emigrate'. In Islamic context, it refers to the act of leaving one's homeland to follow a religious pilgrimage to Makkah, known as the Hajj. The name Haajirah carries the meaning “One who migrates, emigrates” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haajirah usually hope their child will grow to embody one who migrates, emigrates and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies a journey towards self-improvement and closeness to Allah
data.etymology: Haajirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who migrates, emigrates.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haajirah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
